title: AdiBhashaa: A Community-Curated Benchmark for Machine Translation into Indian Tribal Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance disparities using automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF++) and human validation to measure models' capabilities on four under-represented Indian tribal languages (Bhili, Mundari, Gondi, and Santali) compared to high-resource languages like Hindi and English.

Implementing a human-in-the-loop participatory workflow where native speakers and community validators review translations for cultural fidelity, appropriateness, and sensitivity to ensure the models and datasets preserve community norms.
